# aether_loadbalancers (Data Source)

Public addresses allocated to the cluster: `cp_lb` is the cluster's own API endpoint, `ccm_lb` a tenant LoadBalancer Service (`service_ref` = its UID); the DNS name is not exposed by the API today (aether-api issue).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `loadbalancers` (Attributes List) The addresses, in the API's order (by allocation time, then address). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancers))

<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancers`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_at` (String) Allocation time (RFC 3339); null when the platform did not record one.
- `ip` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `purpose` (String) `cp_lb` (the cluster's API endpoint) or `ccm_lb` (a tenant LoadBalancer Service).
- `service_ref` (String) UID of the tenant Service a `ccm_lb` address belongs to; null otherwise.
